name: io.github.WYRE-AI/island-mcp
title: Island Browser
description: MCP server for Island Browser's Admin Actions, Audit, Compromised Credential, and Device APIs.

environmentVariables.name: ISLAND_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Island API key (custom Api-Key header, generated in the Island Management Console). It only ever holds a live API key.

environmentVariables.name: ISLAND_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional override of the Island Management API base URL. Defaults to https://management.island.io/api.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode for the server. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Credential source: 'env' reads vars locally, 'gateway' expects header injection from the WYRE MCP Gateway.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
